changelog:
Dog Train-O-Matic v1.0.0

- Initial release: Personalized, breed-and-age-aware dog training plan generator
- Supports common behavior issues with week-by-week progressions and breed-instinct appropriate outlets
- Automatically adjusts plans based on progress logs or plateaus
- Includes red-flag screening for cases needing professional referral
- Usable for obedience, socialization schedules, and breed exercise insights
- Emphasizes force-free, positive reinforcement only
summary: Generate a personalized, breed-and-age-aware dog training program: 5-minute daily exercise plans targeting the owner's specific behavior problems, week-by-week progression, breed drive profiles (herding/hunting/guarding energy outlets), and progress tracking with automatic plan adjustment. Use when the user asks for a dog training plan, help with a behavior problem (pulling, barking, jumping, recall failure, separation anxiety), puppy raising schedules, or wants to know why their breed behaves a certain way.
